QuestInfo.name: Strange Deal
QuestInfo.0: Find Al Scapone in front of the Gyro Drop and get 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes.
QuestInfo.1:
Al Scapone offered you 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes if you defeat 250 Colabears.
Defeat the Colabears and retrieve the Picnic Lunch Boxes.
QuestInfo.2: You got 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes after defeating all those Colabears. Your mesos aren't worth anything here!

0.0: Welcome one and all, to Fantasy Theme World! What would you like?\r\n#L0##bFive Picnic Lunch Boxes please, and hold the sass.#l\n#k
0.1: Five delicious lunches it is! That will cost you... 250 Colabears.\r\n#L0##bCan't I pay with mesos?#l\n#k
0.2: Meso? What's a meso? The only currency we accept here is FUN! All that stands between you and lunch is 250 Colabears!

yes.0: I'll get your lunch ready. Good luck with those Colabears!

no.0: Have it your way. A hungry guest is a spendy guest!

yes.0: Lunch for five is served. Enjoy!

mob.0: That'll be 250 Colabears for 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes. You need to hurry before I eat them myself!
